decisionsTitle: «De la parteneri»: a partner's or sponsor's name on a registration, a line and an invitation
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-11**, asked to see who came through one of the club's partners or sponsors, with the partner's name, wherever the person appears in the backoffice. The same day, of a partners' guest written on the internal list without an address: «trebuie să pot să-i dau un loc, că e de la parteneri» («A line of the internal list on the Administrator's own address, as a special guest»). Until now «de la parteneri» lived only in a note's words, which no list filters and no column counts.

**Decision: one column, a name or none.** One nullable `partner_name` on `registrations`, on `event_reserve_entries` (a line of «Lista internă (doar notițe)») and on `event_invitations`: a name present means «de la parteneri», none means not — no separate flag beside it, so the two can never disagree. Trimmed, 1 to 120 characters, one CHECK on each table; one expand-only migration (`0199_partner_mark`), nothing backfilled.

**The tick and its box.** Every screen that sets it shows the tick «E de la parteneri» and, with it, the box «Numele partenerului sau sponsorului». The box is what is stored; the tick without a name is refused at the box in one plain sentence (`PARTNER_NAME_MISSING`), what was typed kept; unticking clears the name. The box suggests the names already written at this event — on its registrations, its lines and its invitations — each once whatever its capitals, the newest spelling first, from a native `<datalist>` as the sponsors' recipient box does, so one partner keeps one spelling — also when one partner has hundreds of rows: each of the three reads takes one row per name (`DISTINCT ON` the lower-cased name, its newest write and that write's spelling) before the window of fifty, so a partner with many rows never pushes an older partner's name out. «Newest» is when the row holding the spelling was last written (`updated_at` for a registration), so a registration touched later for another reason can bring an older spelling forward; a `partner_set_at` column would order it by the mark alone, if that ever matters.

**Where it is set, and who may.**
- On a line of the internal list — at «Adaugă pe lista internă» and in a small fold of its own beside «Corectează numele» — by whoever may add and note a line: the Organizer and above (`canKeepRegistrationNotes`), asserted in the service and at the action.
- At an invitation's send — one tick and one name for the whole press, applying to every person of it, as the send's «Elită» and «Pe lista de invitați speciali» do — by whoever may invite: the Administrator.
- On a registration — a small card «De la parteneri» on its page — by the Administrator alone (`canManageRegistrations`, asserted in `setRegistrationPartnerAction` and in `partner-mark.ts#setRegistrationPartner`); the Organizer sees the chip and is handed no form.

**It travels with the person.** Every move of a line that makes a registration carries the name onto it in the move's own transaction — «Mută pe lista oficială», «Oferă-i un loc acum» and «Pe adresa mea, invitat special» through the vouched entry (`enterOnWaitlistByStaff`'s `partnerName`), and the full form's «Trece pe lista oficială» through `settleReserveEntry`, beside the note — and a refused move writes nothing. «Mută pe lista de elită» registers nobody and drops it. An invitation's name is written onto the registration exactly where the send's «Elită» is honoured: at the link's press (`acceptInvitation`) and when a registration of the address takes the invitation over (`markInvitationAdopted`), the trail naming the Administrator who sent it. A registration restarted on the same row keeps what staff set: a move or an invitation with no name never clears one.

**Where it is seen — staff only.** A chip «Partener: {name}» (the partners' handshake) on the registrations list's row — in the name column, which the table and the phone cards both draw — on the registration's page, on the internal list's line and on the invitation's row (an accepted one shows its registration's name as it stands now). A filter «De la parteneri» among the list's filters, one condition in the list's one `WHERE`, so its count and its pages honour it, and the export follows it. A column «Partener» in the registrations' Excel and CSV for every role that gets the file, headed in the reader's language, placed after the fixed columns and before «Note interne», which stays the last.

**Where it never is.** No public page (the participants' list, the results, «Cine vine»), no email, not the race-day desk, and not the file given to sponsors — «Descarcă lista pentru sponsori» is a different thing with close words: that file holds people who agreed to offers; this label is the organizers' own. A structural test holds it (`partner-never-leaves.test.ts`): the files that name the column are a reviewed list, and none of those surfaces, nor the allocator, nor the capacity formula, is on it.

**Nothing else changes.** The label touches no state, no place, no count, no email and no declaration; it is in no condition of the allocator or of the capacity formula (`AGENTS.md` §10.6).

**The trail.** Setting, changing or clearing it on a registration writes one row of a new action, `registration.partner_set`: who, when, which registration and whether a name is now present (`{ partner }`, with `via: "reserve"` or `"invitation"` when it was carried) — never the name typed. The registration's «Istoric» says it in words, «De la parteneri: numele partenerului schimbat», with no name in it. On a line, `event_reserve.added` gains `partner: true` and the fold writes `event_reserve.partner_saved` (`{ entryId, partner }`); at a send, `event.invitation_sent` gains `partner: true` — ids and flags, as those verbs record their other fields.

**The person's record.** «Toate datele unei persoane» lists the partner's name on each of the person's registrations that has one, and on their lines and invitations: it is something the club holds about the person. The erase and the retention sweep take it with the row; nothing else holds it.

**For the lawyer.** The label is one more internal organizational fact about a registration, kept by the organizers for themselves, of the kind the privacy notice already describes where it says the organizers may keep internal notes about a registration; it is shown to nobody outside the backoffice and given to no partner. No legal text or template changed.

**Decided without the owner** (each easy to change): one tick and one name for a whole send, not one per person; the Administrator alone on a registration's page, while the Organizer sets it on a line, as each surface's own verbs already split; «Partener» before the notes column so the notes stay last, headed in the reader's language as the notes are; the staff entry form (the full form and the one-press «Adaugă pe lista de așteptare») left without the tick for now — a line, an invitation and the registration's own page cover the ways a partner's person arrives, and the page sets it on anyone afterwards; the suggestions read at the Organizer's level, from this event's rows only.

**Refused.** A boolean beside the name (two columns that could disagree); a table of partners to pick from (a name typed with suggestions is enough for a club, and needs no screen to keep the table); the label on any public page, email, the desk or the sponsors' file; the name in the trail; a confirmation dialog (it tells nobody and the same box undoes it); reusing the members' discount codes' own `partnerName`, another column that names the partner a code is from.

**Tested in a browser.** `tests/e2e/partner-mark.spec.ts` (320 px and desktop) walks the internal list (the add with the tick refused at the box without a name, the chip, the line's fold changing the name, unticking clearing it), a registration's page as Administrator (the card, the chip on the page and the list's row, the filter keeping that row) and as Organizer (the chip, no form), each checked for sideways overflow; `tests/e2e/registrations-invite.spec.ts` walks the send's tick (the box appears, a tick without a name is refused at the box with no dialog, the dialog names the partner, the invitation's row wears the chip). The browser run showed that a long name (up to 120 characters) in a chip widened the invitations' table past 320 px, so the status chip has an opt-in `wrap` that lets its label wrap inside the chip; only the chips that show a partner's name (the registrations list's two copies of the row, the registration's page, the internal list's line and the invitations' rows) pass it, a source scan keeps it to them, and every other status chip is drawn exactly as before. The same specs, plus one ordinary chip table at 320 px, were re-run on both projects against a production build.
changelogLine: - **«De la parteneri»** — the tick «E de la parteneri» with the partner's or sponsor's name, on a line of the internal list, at an invitation's send and on a registration's page; the name follows the person onto the registration, shows as «Partener: {name}» to staff, filters the list and fills a «Partener» column in the Excel and the CSV — never public, never emailed, never in the sponsors' file. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given «E de la parteneri» ticked with a name on a line of «Lista internă (doar notițe)» or at an invitation's send, when the line is moved onto the official list («Mută pe lista oficială», «Oferă-i un loc acum», «Pe adresa mea, invitat special», «Trece pe lista oficială») or the invitation is taken up by its link or adopted by a registration of the address, then the registration carries the partner's name in that same transaction, audited `registration.partner_set` without the name; «Mută pe lista de elită» registers nobody and drops it; a tick without a name is refused at the box and writes nothing (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the partner's name, when it is set on a line (at the add or in its fold) only the Organizer and above may, at an invitation's send and on a registration's page only the Administrator may — each asserted in the service and the action, every other role refused FORBIDDEN with nothing written; the Organizer sees the registration's «Partener: {name}» chip and no form (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a registration with a partner's name, then it appears on the backoffice's list (its chip and the filter «De la parteneri», count and pages included), the registration's page, the internal list, «Invitații», the registrations' Excel and CSV (the column «Partener», before «Note interne», which stays last) and «Toate datele unei persoane», and on no public page, email, race-day desk or file given to sponsors, and in no condition of the allocator or the capacity formula; the box's suggestions are the event's earlier names, each once whatever its capitals, newest first, even when one partner has more rows than a read's window; the tick, the box, the chip and the filter are walked in a browser on both projects (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
